steps.label: address
statements: create table address(address_id int64 not null) primary key(address_id)

steps.label: shipping-first
statements: create table sales_order_shipping(shipment_id int64 not null,address_id int64 not null,constraint shipping_address_fk foreign key(address_id) references address(address_id)) primary key(shipment_id)

steps.label: indexes-shipping
steps.sql: SELECT i.TABLE_SCHEMA,i.TABLE_NAME,i.INDEX_NAME,i.IS_UNIQUE,i.IS_NULL_FILTERED,i.SPANNER_IS_MANAGED,c.COLUMN_NAME,c.COLUMN_ORDERING FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES i JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEX_COLUMNS c USING(TABLE_CATALOG,TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME) WHERE i.INDEX_TYPE='INDEX' ORDER BY i.TABLE_NAME,i.INDEX_NAME,c.ORDINAL_POSITION

steps.label: order-collision
statements: create table sales_order(order_id int64 not null,shipping_address_id int64 not null,constraint order_address_fk foreign key(shipping_address_id) references address(address_id)) primary key(order_id)
